action: Save an arXiv page through the popup, the shortcut, the context menu and Save tabs with the rule enabled.
assertion: The native bookmark is created directly under Academic (no create-then-move); the local provider receives no folder request; the result panel names the rule.

action: Delete or unsync the bound folder, then save a matching page.
assertion: The save succeeds at the chosen or default location; the rule stage is blocked with a reason; no alternate classifier is called.

action: Have a worker propose a destination outside the bound subtree, and separately move a valid destination out after the worker read it.
assertion: Both proposals are rejected at commit with a boundary diagnostic recorded on the job.

action: Enable the local provider with tag mode Suggest, then Add, then Off; save a matching page each time.
assertion: Requests carry folder:false,tags:true for Suggest and Add and no request is sent for Off; a local tag result marks the tags task satisfied on the receipt.

action: Submit the same result twice from two devices or attempts; then change the summary contract without changing the bookmark.
assertion: One note and one tag set exist; the old summary is not reused for a different contract.

action: Provide overlapping sibling folders and a worker result with keepParent and two subject tags.
assertion: The bookmark stays at the parent, both tags apply, and no provider score is compared across models.

action: Pick a folder explicitly in the popup while a rule matches; later let a late worker placement arrive.
assertion: The manual folder is kept in both cases and the panel explains the skipped rule.

action: Enable two equal-priority rules with different destinations and save a matching page.
assertion: The bookmark is not moved; it appears under Needs a decision with both rules named; tag additions still apply.

action: Create a matching bookmark with the browser's star button into a bookmark root.
assertion: After the settle window one move is applied, one toast is shown, and the server records one intake covering create and move.

action: Save offline, kill the service worker, restart the browser, reconnect.
assertion: The receipt and native identity survive; the server joins the receipt to the sync operation; no second run exists.

action: Install partial, corrupt, unsupported and expired bundles.
assertion: Automatic effects fail closed with a notice; the previous valid bundle stays in force; saving still works.

action: Project one server move to two browsers.
assertion: Neither browser starts an intake; the intended next stage remains allowed.

action: Rename a bound folder during a partial batch (M3) or with pending jobs (M1).
assertion: The rule sentence refreshes; identity, counters and pending work are unchanged; one informational notice.

action: Move a bound folder inside its allowed scope, then outside, then move an ancestor.
assertion: Inside: notice only. Outside: dependent stages block with the fix named. Ancestor: all dependent rules listed in one notice.

action: Delete a bound folder, create another with the same name, then restore the original.
assertion: No auto-rebind; Restore and Choose another are offered; restore revalidates without replay.

action: Make the worker target unavailable while saving matching pages.
assertion: Placement continues; the rule shows waiting jobs with last-seen time; the rule is degraded, not blocked.

action: List and call tools with an agent that has no automation switch.
assertion: The tool list equals the pre-feature list; direct calls to automation tools are refused.

action: Enable a worker and list tools before any job or subscription exists.
assertion: Worker tools are listed; nothing requires an active subscription.

action: Create two targets on one OAuth client and two on separate clients; route jobs to one.
assertion: Only the intended target lists the job; the shared-client case is labeled as not a security boundary.

action: Admit two bookmarks concurrently with nine waiting in a count-10 rule.
assertion: Exactly one run of ten and one waiting member commit.

action: Retry a source event, run-once 25 bookmarks, then delete a batch member.
assertion: No double count; two runs of ten and five waiting; the deleted member is reported, not replaced.

action: Broadcast per-target analysis; fail one receiver; add a target later.
assertion: Independent results; successful targets are not re-notified; the new target gets no old private work.

action: Remove the local key; make the configured target unavailable; no fallback approved.
assertion: No alternate destination or paid request is attempted; work waits with a visible reason.

action: Edit the note or move the bookmark while a job is leased, then let the result arrive.
assertion: The late result is not applied to the edited field; the job ends stale with the proposal kept where it still makes sense.

action: Expire and reassign a job, then submit from the old generation.
assertion: Old completion and heartbeat fail; one accepted effect set exists.

action: Preview, edit a binding, then try to enable with the old preview; also enable a never-previewed rule from the API.
assertion: Both are refused; a fresh preview of the exact configuration is required.

action: Install one template for two owners with unrelated folder names.
assertion: Both resolve their own roles; no folder is created on install.

action: Upgrade a template to add broadcast or external retrieval.
assertion: A semantic diff and new consent are required; old runs stay pinned; rollback works without replay.

action: Test downtime, the spring gap and the autumn repeat in an IANA zone.
assertion: The stored misfire and DST policy produce deterministic non-empty releases.

action: Submit confirmed, unknown and multi-entity text metadata to a restricted rule.
assertion: Confirmed uses the map and vocabulary; others go to review; no image-based identity; no broadcast.

action: Break the worker and create a structural dependency issue.
assertion: Needs attention lists both with repair actions without the worker; metrics carry no content.

action: Pause a rule with a partial batch, save matching pages, resume.
assertion: Admission stops and resumes with a new fence; the partial batch is kept; nothing from the paused interval is backfilled.

action: Apply a run, edit one affected field by hand, undo the run.
assertion: Only untouched effects revert; the edited field is kept and listed.

action: Register callbacks on private, mixed-DNS, rebinding, metadata and redirecting hosts.
assertion: Verification and every delivery refuse unsafe egress; no COLP credential is forwarded.

action: Sign fixed body bytes; tamper; rotate the secret under concurrent sends.
assertion: Authentic signatures verify; tampering fails; rotation stays bounded.

action: Kill the delivery worker after a remote 2xx and before local acknowledgment.
assertion: The same event may be delivered twice; claims and effect receipts prevent a second effect.

action: Revoke the agent or the source access while work is queued, leased and about to commit.
assertion: Future delivery, read and write stop under fresh checks; already-read data cannot be recalled and is documented as such.

action: Expire history and restore a backup with pending attempts.
assertion: No silent state loss; the server starts with automation paused; attempts are marked uncertain.

action: Stress many rules, deep predicates, large run-once sets and a slow worker.
assertion: Saving stays available; evaluation and queues are bounded; measured capacity is recorded.

action: Change a schema, example, tool descriptor or generated client; add a migration with a prefix below the current head.
assertion: CI catches closed-schema, example, route-catalog, generated-client drift and the out-of-order migration.

action: From a folder's Automate action, add one condition, preview, enable, as a new user following the shipped docs.
assertion: Completed under two minutes without seeing JSON; the rule sentence appears in the list.

action: Create a matching bookmark in the web library under a root folder, then one through MCP, then one directly in a specific folder.
assertion: The first two are placed by rule with an automation version; the third is untouched; browsers receive projections without new intake.

scenario: Why is it here, single undo
action: Open an automated bookmark; undo one effect; edit a field and undo its effect.
assertion: The Automation section lists rule, agent and time; the first undo reverts one effect; the second refuses with an explanation.

action: Turn on Pause all; save matching pages on two browsers; list jobs as a worker; resume.
assertion: No admission or local placement after one bundle refresh; workers get paused; resume does not process paused saves; they are listed for run-once.

action: Set a target to poll; run a Claude Code routine and a cron script on the HTTP work API against ready jobs.
assertion: Each lists, claims, reads with nodes.get and submits; the note and tags appear with attribution; no write tool was needed; the rule page states the polling interval.

action: Submit results for a Manual agent and a Trusted agent.
assertion: Manual waits on Approvals with rule and job named; Trusted commits with a version and Undo; no irreversible plan can be built.

action: Exceed a rule's daily cap and the server-wide job cap.
assertion: Bookmarks are still placed by rule; tasks are held with a visible reason; counts show on the rule page.

action: Complete a ten-member batch with a digest result.
assertion: The digest is readable on the run page with members linked; the Automations page shows an unread count; the extension badge shows it once.

action: Star a matching page into Other bookmarks; star another and pick a non-root folder in the dialog.
assertion: The first is moved by rule; the second is kept as the Owner's choice.

action: Run a rule once over an imported folder of 25 matching bookmarks with and without the move-foldered option.
assertion: Preview counts match; one manual run with pinned members; effects are undoable; the run never repeats.

action: Open a target on a loopback server, a tls-internal LAN server and a public HTTPS server.
assertion: The first two default to poll and state why; the third defaults to events and offers pairing; the Owner can override in both directions and the rule page reflects the mode.

action: Create rules; run backup.sh, restore.sh on a fresh stack, colp-server export and the web Export menu.
assertion: Rules and bindings return; the restored server is paused until resumed; automations.json is present without secrets.

action: With a target in events mode and a real hosted bot subscribed, save a matching page.
assertion: One signed wake-up is delivered within seconds of the job becoming ready; the bot claims, reads with nodes.get and submits; the note and tags appear; a duplicate delivery produces no second effect.

action: Create m1-rule-create without policy/target
assertion: Rule validates, saves and places without querying M2 tables

action: Serialize pre-save and corrective-move receipts; inject nativeObservation
assertion: Valid receipts join canonical operations; nativeObservation is rejected and summary satisfaction cannot be asserted

scenario: Pause cache rollback and offline bound
action: Install paused settings N, then active N-1; test offline expiry
assertion: Older snapshot cannot revive a known pause; disconnected latency is exposed and no model is invoked

action: Compare /docs/a and /other/docs/a with /docs/
assertion: Only the literal prefix matches; contains is not used for startsWith

action: Delay receipt, make explicit move, then resume ingest
assertion: No delayed intake effect overwrites the manual placement

action: Select effect ID; repeat after content revision advances
assertion: Safe compensation only; stale/unknown prior destination is refused; saved bookmark is never deleted

action: Pair a worker without manager; list queued jobs via both transports
assertion: Only bootstrap pair before binding; authorized list returns deliveryHandle; no manager privilege escalation

action: Retry exact body with later timestamp; return 413 for one item
assertion: Fresh timestamp/signature; identical event/body; oversized occurrence terminal without disabling healthy target

action: Lose nonreplayable wake, reconnect, call jobs.list
assertion: Durable ready job remains claimable without historical event replay

action: Crash after canonical commit but before job terminal update
assertion: Stable plan/operation identity reconciles receipt; accepted effect not executed twice

action: Start without preview, change members/options, exceed cap
assertion: Shape rejection or stale/over-limit error; no silent re-query/truncation

action: Replay duplicate 10th event while admitting an 11th
assertion: One 10-member batch, one remainder member, no duplicate accepted job

action: Read through output A while B arrives
assertion: A marked read; B remains unread and visible on subsequent page

action: Export and reinstall enabled source rule
assertion: No live target/collection IDs or secrets; reinstall is draft until rebinding and preview

action: Resolve accession then classify with metadata/folderDefinitions
assertion: Accepted predecessor evidence available; group destination confined to catalogRoot; ambiguity goes to review

action: Signed out, create a site rule in Options; save a matching page from the popup, also offline
assertion: Bookmark created directly in the rule's folder; popup showed it as By rule before Save; an explicit folder wins; no request reaches a server

action: Signed in, save a page an account rule and a browser rule both match, then a page only the browser rule matches
assertion: First save follows the account rule's outcome and is receipted; second is filed by the browser rule with no receipt; paused or absent account rules leave browser rules working

action: Connect with browser rules that duplicate, conflict with, ignore, sit outside or lost their folder against the bundle
assertion: Each rule labelled duplicate/conflict/independent/local only/broken; conflict shows the replay count; Keep both, Use the account's and Remove persist and reappear when the account rule changes

scenario: Web editor filled from a browser rule
action: Open /automations/new with collectionId, folderId, name, combinator and condition parameters
assertion: Form shows the name, conditions and folder; nothing is created before Save; unknown kinds and empty values are dropped

scenario: Browser rule moves to the account
action: Choose Add mine to the account, enable the rule on the web, refresh the bundle
assertion: Browser copy retires only after the enabled duplicate arrives; a draft or a rule with other conditions leaves it in place; an unsynced folder cannot move

action: Disconnect with a bundle, receipts, intents, server status and browser rules present
assertion: The account's automation data is gone from the browser; browser rules remain and still place saves
